prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1086; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane on a Pasadena, Texas roadway and began a left turn when the front of the vehicle collided with the side of Driver 2's vehicle, which was proceeding straight through the intersection. Driver 1 was identified as the registered operator and is named on the applicable policy. Driver 1 reported a wrist fracture and stated that a passenger was seated in the front passenger position at the time of impact. Responding officers and statements from both drivers confirm that a passenger was present in the vehicle. No independent witnesses were located at the scene, so the account relies on the statements of those involved and on photographs taken at the location. The photographs confirm the general position of both vehicles and the area of damage, which is largely consistent with the reported angle of impact. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was observed or reported by either party. At this time it is not yet clear whether the wrist injury resulted from this collision, and medical records have been requested to clarify the matter.
